integrity: Proof is self-contained after the established Hermite-Laguerre ambiguity identity; a symbolic checker confirms the exact algebraic certificate. Historical novelty is provisional, and independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem optimizes the Gaussian-relative squared ambiguity multiplier for exactly three positive-order Hermite windows and nonnegative unit-sum exposure weights. It does not establish global unweighted inversion stability, arbitrary-order optimality, or nonlinear phase-retrieval stability. Strictly positive weights cannot attain the optimum.
title: Exact minimax ambiguity coverage by three consecutive non-Gaussian Hermite windows
